name: China
blurb: Imperial history, megacities and otherworldly karst landscapes.

The Forbidden City and the Great Wall.
Shanghai
Art deco Bund, skyline views and soup dumplings.
Yangshuo
Karst peaks, river rafting and cycling through rice paddies.
Xi'an

Chengdu

Zhangjiajie
Towering sandstone pillars and a glass bridge.
Hangzhou
West Lake's gardens and green tea hills.
Wudang Mountains
